original_test_intent.statement: Validate a two-node NCCL collective across the approved GPU/fabric topology, including correctness and comparable bandwidth, after controlled setup.

conditions_present: Two-node/OpenMPI intent and NCCL performance criterion are stated.
missing: Nodes, managed trust, stack/build, rank/fabric map, collective/matrix/check, threshold and cleanup.

revision_candidate.test_name: Validate Two-Node NCCL with Managed Access and a Signed Matrix
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the approved two-node NCCL collective matrix across the exact GPU/network topology, verify reduction correctness and complete performance evidence, and compare algorithm and bus bandwidth separately with a matching NVIDIA reference.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Two named nodes, exact GPU/NIC/NVLink/NVSwitch/PCIe/NUMA map, pinned driver/CUDA/NCCL/OpenMPI/PMIx/libfabric/plugin/NCCL-tests builds and a managed least-privilege launcher identity.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Signed ranks/GPUs per node, collective/type/reduction/modes, message sizes, warmups and iterations. The 10-minute Machine Time cannot truncate the matrix; a revised duration requires engineer approval.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Node/rank/GPU/NIC map; credential owner/expiry/revocation/host-key proof; build hashes; interface/GID/MTU/RDMA/GDR/plugin/fallback policy; complete matrix and correctness mode; algbw/busbw thresholds/reference; ports, limits and recovery approvals.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Using only the managed identity and explicit hostfile, verify build/rank mapping and run the full signed NCCL-tests matrix with correctness checking, full stdout and unique per-rank debug logs. Prove selected interface/plugin/transport, collect fabric/GPU/host evidence, terminate recorded processes and revoke/remove only approved temporary access/state.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Isolated healthy nodes/fabric; managed trust tested; exact stack/matrix/reference approved; no competing load; abort/cleanup ready.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Credential/host-key lifecycle proof; both-node topology/software maps and hashes; hostfile/ranks/commands/environment; selected transport/plugin; complete per-message/mode/iteration correctness, time, algbw and busbw; per-rank logs; NIC/RDMA/NVLink/XID/ECC/power/thermal/host logs; comparison; key/state cleanup and final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed reference matching two-node topology, software, transport, ranks, collective and matrix. Pass requires complete correctness and performance evidence, no unintended fallback/hang and clean final health; setup success is not completion.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not create persistent root keys, disable host verification, expose secrets, treat `/etc/hosts` as a hostfile, install latest code, guess ranks/interfaces, truncate logs, auto-retry hangs or leave credentials/processes behind.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Security, node, fabric and software owners approve trust, changes, matrix/reference and load; human judges result.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans provision/revoke access and sign topology/reference. Agent executes frozen matrix after gates.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: Terminate tracked ranks/daemons, preserve logs/counters, restore package/network state, revoke temporary credentials and verify both nodes/GPUs/NICs before rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Credential ownership/expiry, stack, topology, matrix, reference or approval missing; wrong rank/interface/plugin/fallback; correctness error, hang, link/GPU/host limit, monitoring loss or cleanup/revocation failure.

identified_defects: Persistent root trust is proposed without lifecycle controls.
No NCCL benchmark command or rank/fabric matrix.
reason_for_change: This row's distinctive risk is unmanaged root credential creation; V3 makes trust provisioning and revocation part of the execution contract while still requiring a real NCCL run.
